"'''Dance Until You Drop'''" was a [[Music|song]] performed by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. The song was performed at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] sometime after the enslavement of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia Organa]].<ref name="Kinect" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"Dance Until You Drop" was introduced in the [[2010]] video game ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', in which an instrumental version is played during cutscenes of the Galactic Dance Off mode.<ref name="Kinect" />

The song was originally composed by [[Kevin Afflack]], with [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] lyrics translated by [[Jesse Harlin]]. While an official soundtrack was never released for ''Kinect Star Wars'', the full version of the song was uploaded to [[wikipedia:SoundCloud|SoundCloud]] by Afflack in [[2013]], featuring lead vocals by [[Brina Palencia]] and [[Chris Sabat]].<ref name="SoundCloud">{{WebCite|url=https://soundcloud.com/kevinafflack/dance-until-you-drop-huttese|text=Dance Until You Drop-Huttese|archiveurl=https://archive.is/VTRrf}}</ref>
